outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) with SD error bars across genotypes, but no individual data points (from N=4 mice, n>100 cells) are overlaid on the bars.
The lower graph shows mean ± SD percentage of aggregate-positive Purkinje cells as bars only; individual data points from the N=4 mice (n>400 cells) are not shown.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod across weeks) with mean ± SD; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance across days at three time points) showing mean ± SD; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve, a type of line plot, which is exempt from needing overlaid individual data points.
Panel G shows immunofluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot, so this check does not apply.

Panel H contains two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number) presented as mean ± SD across N=3 experiments (n=9 mice each), but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
